The magnetic levitation induction technique was utilized to melt a mixture of elemental Al, Co, Cr, Fe, and Ni with the purity of >99.9% in a high-purity argon atmosphere, to produce the Al0.3CoCrFeNi (at.%) HEA ingots. The melting temperature was 1600◦C. The ingots were re-melted four times to ensure the chemical homogeneity and then poured into the rectangular steel mold at room temperature. The pouring temperature was 1400◦C.
The plates were homogenized at 1150◦C for 24 h followed by water cooling, and then cold-rolled to ~70% thickness reduction along the longitudinal direction.
